bundle.guidance:
# Keboola Website

Public-facing content in Keboola's brand: landing pages, launch notes,
customer stories, partner one-pagers. Confident, technical, warm — enterprise
credibility without enterprise stiffness.

## Principles

1. **Proof over adjectives.** A customer number, a named integration or a
   measured result beats a claim. Every section should contain something
   verifiable.
2. **Rhythm by section.** The page is a stack of full-width bands that
   alternate between the white page and the tinted `--color-bg-card`, with
   generous `--space-xl` padding. The alternation is the navigation.
3. **Blue is the point.** One brand blue, used for action and emphasis and
   nothing decorative.

## Layout grid

Full-width sections; content capped at `64rem` and centred, with
`--space-lg` of side padding. Cards sit in a flex or grid row of two to three
and stack below `48rem`. A section is a heading, at most two paragraphs of
lead, and one group of cards, a chart or a diagram. Never two content groups
in one band.

## Typography

Manrope throughout — Keboola's typeface — with weight carrying hierarchy.
Section headings at `--size-h2` with `--line-tight` and slight negative
tracking; the page title at `--size-h1`. Body at `--size-body`, lead
paragraphs at `--size-h3` in `--color-text-secondary`. Code, connector names
and CLI fragments are monospace.

## Colour usage

White page, `--color-bg-card` (#f6f8fc) for alternating bands, deep navy
(`--color-deep-navy`) for the occasional inverted band and the footer. Brand
blue `--color-brand-primary` (#097cf7) for buttons, links and the primary
chart series; `--color-deep-blue-dark` for hover. Teal `ok`, yellow `warn` and
coral `danger` are accents for metrics and badges, never large areas. Keep at
most one inverted navy band per page.

## Charts

Chart.js. Bar and line, brand blue first, teal second. Charts illustrate a
proof point and always carry a caption naming the source and period. No
gridline clutter, no 3-D, no more than four series. A single metric is better
shown as a `stat-band` than as a chart.

## Diagrams

Mermaid `flowchart LR` for architecture and data-flow pictures — source to
Keboola to destination. Keep to seven nodes, label edges with the data being
moved, and never colour nodes individually.

## Components and when to use each

- `hero` — the page opener: title, one lead sentence, one primary action.
  Exactly one per page.
- `section-band` — the alternating full-width wrapper every section uses.
- `feature-card` — one capability or use case, in a row of two or three.
- `stat-band` — two to four proof numbers in a row, under the hero or after a
  customer story.
- `quote-card` — a customer testimonial with name, role and company.
- `cta` — the closing action block. One per page, at the end.

## Do / don't

- **Do** name real products, connectors and customers where permitted.
- **Do** keep the primary action to one verb: "Start free", "Book a demo".
- **Don't** reuse Keboola's logo, wordmark or marketing copy inside a
  document; this design system carries the look, not the brand assets.
- **Don't** stack two inverted navy bands, and never put body text on the
  brand blue.
- **Don't** use more than one exclamation mark per page — ideally none.
